    "vitest": "^4.1.11"
  },

    "node": ">=20.0.0"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "lint-staged": {
    "*.{json,md,yaml}": "prettier --write",
    "*.{ts,mts,mjs,js}": [
      "eslint --fix",
      "prettier --write"
    ]
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.30.3",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "build": "pnpm -r --if-present build",
    "check": "pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm test",
    "fix:format": "prettier --write .",
    "fix:lint": "eslint --fix . --ignore-pattern 'extensions/**' && pnpm -r --filter './extensions/*' --if-present fix:lint",
    "image": "rm -rf .build && create-upload-image .build",
    "lint": "pnpm lint:types && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:format",
    "lint:eslint": "eslint . --ignore-pattern 'extensions/**' && pnpm -r --filter './extensions/*' --if-present lint:eslint",
    "lint:format": "prettier --check .",
    "lint:types": "pnpm -r --if-present lint:types",
    "postimage": "cp pnpm-lock.yaml .build/",
    "preimage": "pnpm install --lockfile-only && pnpm build && pnpm lint:types && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm test",
    "prepare": "husky",
    "stripe:regen": "gen-workspace --package-dir .",
    "test": "node tools/test.js",
    "test:watch": "vitest watch",
    "clean": "rm -rf node_modules .build && find extensions -maxdepth 2 \\( -name node_modules -o -name dist \\) -type d -exec rm -rf {} +"
  }
}

{
  "name": "price_targeted_amount_off",
  "version": "1.0.1",
  "description": "Price-targeted amount off",
  "private": true,
  "license": "~~proprietary~~",
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm build:schemas",
    "build:schemas": "gen-schemas --root ../.. --extension-id \"$npm_package_name\" --out-dir generated --schema-name config",
    "lint": "pnpm lint:types && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:format",
    "lint:types": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "lint:eslint": "eslint .",
    "lint:format": "prettier --list-different .; s=$?; [ $s -eq 1 ] && printf '\\nThe files above are not formatted. Run pnpm fix:format to fix.\\n' >&2; exit $s",
    "fix:lint": "eslint --fix .",
    "fix:format": "prettier --write .",
    "test": "pnpm test:types && pnpm test:vitest",
    "test:types": "tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit",
    "test:vitest": "vitest --root ../.. run --project \"$npm_package_name\"",
    "test:watch": "pnpm test:vitest --watch",
    "dev": "concurrently -n build,lint,test -c blue,yellow,green 'tsc -p tsconfig.json -w --noEmit' 'chokidar \"src/**/*.{ts,json}\" -c \"eslint .\"' 'pnpm test:vitest --watch --no-clear-screen'",
    "stripe:regen": "gen-workspace --root ../.. --package-dir . --template-id commerce.discount_calculation"
  },
  "lint-staged": {
    "*.{ts,mts,mjs,js}": [
      "eslint --fix",
      "prettier --write"

    "*.{json,md,yaml}": "prettier --write"

    "@stripe/extensibility-sdk": "4.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@stripe/extensibility-language-server": "^1.0.2"
  }
}

# Stripe coupon extensions

Official first-party Stripe App containing reference implementations for custom coupon and discounting extensions.

These extensions implement the `commerce.discount_calculation` interface, allowing you to override standard Stripe discounting behavior—enabling granular control over how discounts are calculated, applied, and combined across invoices and subscriptions.

---

## Documentation

- [Stripe authored scripts](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/scripts/stripe-authored/discount-calculation) — Additional documentation on these Stripe Authored Scripts 
- [Authoring your own scripts](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/scripts/discount-calculation) — Step by step guide on creating your own custom coupons.
- [Stripe apps framework](https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-apps) — Apps, extension packaging, manifests, and distribution.

---

## Available extensions

| Extension                      | Interface                       | Description                                                                                 |
| :----------------------------- | :------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Percent off up to maximum**  | `commerce.discount_calculation` | Applies a percentage discount to the invoice total, capped at a specified monetary ceiling. |
| **BOGO & quantity promos**     | `commerce.discount_calculation` | Configures buy-X-get-Y promotional logic based on matching product metadata.                |
| **Price-targeted percent off** | `commerce.discount_calculation` | Applies a percentage discount strictly to line items with matching price metadata.          |
| **Price-targeted amount off**  | `commerce.discount_calculation` | Deducts a fixed monetary amount per matching line item based on price metadata.             |

---

### 1. Percent off up to maximum

Calculates `percentageDiscount` against the gross invoice total and caps the resulting discount at `maximumDiscount`.

> **Currency requirement:** `maximumDiscount` must match the invoice currency. A currency mismatch results in `$0` applied discount.

- **Example:** On a 20% discount with a $50 maximum:
  - $100 invoice total --> **$20 discount**
  - $500 invoice total --> **$50 discount** (capped)

#### Configuration schema

| Field                | Type              | Description                                                        |
| :------------------- | :---------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `percentageDiscount` | `Percentage`      | Discount rate as a decimal float between `0` and `1` (0% to 100%). |
| `maximumDiscount`    | `Monetary amount` | Maximum allowable discount amount.                                 |

---

### 2. BOGO & quantity promos

Filters products via exact metadata key/value matching. Quantities are aggregated by product ID, and promotional logic applies independently per matching product. When a product has multiple effective unit prices, discounts apply to the lowest unit cost first.

- **Example:** For `purchaseQuantity: 3` and `freeQuantity: 2`:
  - Purchase **3 units** --> 0 free units (threshold met, no promo triggered)
  - Purchase **4 or 5 units** --> 1 or 2 free units discounted
  - Purchase **6+ units** --> 2 free units discounted (capped at `freeQuantity`)

#### Configuration schema

| Field                   | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :---------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `purchaseQuantity`      | `Integer` | Minimum paid unit threshold required before free units apply. |
| `freeQuantity`          | `Integer` | Maximum number of eligible free units per order.              |
| `metadataMatcher`       | `Object`  | Product metadata filtering rules.                             |
| `metadataMatcher.key`   | `String`  | Target product metadata key.                                  |
| `metadataMatcher.value` | `String`  | Target product metadata value (exact match).                  |

---

### 3. Price-targeted percent off

Evaluates invoice line items using exact metadata key/value matching against the line's corresponding price object. Applies `percentageOff` to each qualifying line item subtotal and returns the sum as the total invoice discount.

#### Configuration schema

| Field                   | Type         | Description                                                        |
| :---------------------- | :----------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `percentageOff`         | `Percentage` | Discount rate as a decimal float between `0` and `1` (0% to 100%). |
| `metadataMatcher`       | `Object`     | Price metadata filtering rules.                                    |
| `metadataMatcher.key`   | `String`     | Target price metadata key.                                         |
| `metadataMatcher.value` | `String`     | Target price metadata value (exact match).                         |

---

### 4. Price-targeted amount off

Evaluates invoice line items using exact metadata key/value matching against the line's corresponding price object. Applies `fixedAmountOff` once per qualifying line (capped at that line's individual subtotal) and returns the aggregated discount total.

> **Currency Requirement:** `fixedAmountOff` must match the invoice currency.

#### Configuration schema

| Field                   | Type              | Description                                   |
| :---------------------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------- |
| `fixedAmountOff`        | `Monetary amount` | Fixed amount deducted per eligible line item. |
| `metadataMatcher`       | `Object`          | Price metadata filtering rules.               |
| `metadataMatcher.key`   | `String`          | Target price metadata key.                    |
| `metadataMatcher.value` | `String`          | Target price metadata value (exact match).    |

---

## Development setup

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js:** `>= 20.0.0`
- **pnpm:** `>= 10.0.0`

### Installation & commands

```bash
# Install workspace dependencies
pnpm install

# Compile extension packages
pnpm build

# Execute test suite (Vitest)
pnpm test

# Run ESLint across workspace
pnpm lint

# Execute full validation pipeline (Build + Lint + Test)
pnpm check
```

## Project structure

```
coupon-extensions/
├── extensions/                 # One package per extension (pnpm workspace)
│   └── <extension_id>/
│       ├── src/index.ts        # Extension implementation
│       ├── src/index.test.ts   # Tests
│       ├── generated/          # Generated configuration and UI schemas
│       ├── package.json
│       ├── tsconfig.json
│       └── vitest.config.mts
├── stripe-app.yaml             # App manifest — extension registration
├── package.json                # Workspace root
├── pnpm-workspace.yaml
├── tsconfig.base.json          # Shared TypeScript config
├── eslint.config.mts
└── vitest.config.base.mts
```

Each extension is a self-contained pnpm workspace package under `extensions/`. The `stripe-app.yaml` manifest registers all extensions and points to their configuration schemas and entry points.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development guidelines and how to submit changes.

$schema: https://stripe.com/stripe-app/v2.0.0/schema
id: com.stripe.coupon.extensions
name: Stripe Coupon Extensions
version: 1.0.1
icon: ./assets/icon.png
declarations:
  distribution_type: public
  sandbox_install_compatible: true
extensions:
  - id: percent_off_up_to_maximum
    name: Percent off up to maximum
    description: |
      Apply a percentage discount to the invoice total, capped at a configured maximum. No discount is applied when the invoice currency differs from the configured currency.
    interface_id: commerce.discount_calculation
    version: 1.0.1
    configuration:
      input_schema:
        type: json_schema
        content: extensions/percent_off_up_to_maximum/generated/config.schema.json
      ui_schema:
        type: jsonforms
        content: extensions/percent_off_up_to_maximum/generated/config.ui.json
    script:
      type: typescript
      content: extensions/percent_off_up_to_maximum/src/index.ts
    permissions: []
    methods:
      compute_discounts:
        implementation_type: script
  - id: buy_x_get_y_free
    name: BOGO and quantity promos
    description: |
      Create quantity-based promotions for products with matching metadata. Discount up to a configured number of units after a configurable purchase threshold, including promotions where the threshold is zero and eligible units are free immediately.
    interface_id: commerce.discount_calculation
    version: 1.0.1
    configuration:
      input_schema:
        type: json_schema
        content: extensions/buy_x_get_y_free/generated/config.schema.json
      ui_schema:
        type: jsonforms
        content: extensions/buy_x_get_y_free/generated/config.ui.json
    script:
      type: typescript
      content: extensions/buy_x_get_y_free/src/index.ts
    permissions: []
    methods:
      compute_discounts:
        implementation_type: script
  - id: price_targeted_percent_off
    name: Price-targeted percent off
    description: |
      Apply a percentage discount to invoice line items whose prices contain a matching metadata key and value.
    interface_id: commerce.discount_calculation
    version: 1.0.1
    configuration:
      input_schema:
        type: json_schema
        content: extensions/price_targeted_percent_off/generated/config.schema.json
      ui_schema:
        type: jsonforms
        content: extensions/price_targeted_percent_off/generated/config.ui.json
    script:
      type: typescript
      content: extensions/price_targeted_percent_off/src/index.ts
    permissions: []
    methods:
      compute_discounts:
        implementation_type: script
  - id: price_targeted_amount_off
    name: Price-targeted amount off
    description: |
      Apply a fixed monetary discount to each invoice line item whose price contains a matching metadata key and value. No discount is applied when the invoice currency differs from the configured currency. If the discount amount exceeds the line item subtotal, the line item subtotal will be fully discounted.
    interface_id: commerce.discount_calculation
    version: 1.0.1
    configuration:
      input_schema:
        type: json_schema
        content: extensions/price_targeted_amount_off/generated/config.schema.json
      ui_schema:
        type: jsonforms
        content: extensions/price_targeted_amount_off/generated/config.ui.json
    script:
      type: typescript
      content: extensions/price_targeted_amount_off/src/index.ts
    permissions: []
    methods:
      compute_discounts:
        implementation_type: script
